notes.general_comments:
Technical accuracy tended to be more secure in Section B than in Section A, where tense errors and
confusions often impacted coherence. Section B responses were also often structured more effectively than
Section A responses.
Quite a number of submissions self-penalised on the grounds of rubric infringement: some essays were
appreciably short of the minimum word limit. Candidates should practise writing time-limited tasks to a
specific word length.
